notes: Use Material as the product base; join Prices and Stock to Material on MATNR, never by row position.
Preserve leading zeros: MATNR values such as 00470001 and EAN11 values such as 0885001230000 must be treated as text, not integers.
Stock contains 24 rows: 12 MATNRs by two warehouses, BKK and CNX. The inventory row key is MATNR plus Warehouse.
Available pieces is already stated in individual pieces by the Legend; do not multiply inventory by the 12-unit carton pack size.
Prices explicitly state Price list = standard, WAERS = THB, VAT included = No, and Tax rate = 5%; map VAT included to false and the explicit tax rate to 0.05.
Legend confirms MEINS CTN = CARTON and that stock is counted in pieces.
No effective dates or product status column is present; leave optional effective_from, effective_to and status mappings unused rather than inferring values.

changes_from_draft: Removed the unused 'products_3' source (Legend sheet). It is a reference sheet (CTN = CARTON, 'Stock basis') with only 2 rows and must not generate product records; its content was used as evidence for the unit and inventory decisions.
Tightened file name patterns to 'material', 'prices', 'inventory' to match the three real uploads (material.xlsx, prices.xlsx, inventory.xlsx).
/sku and /barcode now cast to string after trim, so MATNR '00470001' and EAN11 '0885001230000' keep their leading zeros instead of becoming numbers.
Added the missing /prices/*/vat_rate mapping: 'Tax rate' is an explicit source column with 5% on every row → 0.05 via parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction=true). No inferred tax rate.
/unit/pack_size now casts 'Units per carton' (12 on all rows) to integer directly; the pack_size parser was unnecessary for a plain numeric column.
/unit/sell_unit: MEINS 'CTN' is normalised to CARTON by unit_normalize, consistent with the Legend sheet definition and with the target enum_hint.

Added /currency from explicit source evidence: WAERS = 'THB' on all 12 price rows. It is emitted as a constant because there is no direct join from the Material root frame; no FX conversion is performed.
/prices/*/price_list simplified to lowercase(trim('Price list')) — the source says 'standard' explicitly on every row, matching the contract default and the operator instruction.
Record dedupe set on /sku (keep first), and quality rules strengthened: sku unique+not_null (error), product_name not_null (error), currency ISO regex, amount positive as warning.

Not mapped because the source has no such columns and the contract marks them optional with defaults: /status (schema default 'active'), /prices/*/effective_from, /prices/*/effective_to, /brand, /category, /description, /inventory/*/reserved. Nothing was invented for them.
Inventory qty stays in individual pieces — the Legend sheet states stock is already counted in pieces, so no multiplication by the 12-piece carton size was applied.
Dropped the draft question about the Legend 'Code' column: 'CTN' is a unit code, not a currency; currency is explicitly stated in the Prices sheet WAERS column.
